exponent `3`.

BookProof_MajoranaClifford_a_selfAdjoint.title: Self-adjointness of the field operator** (the book's `a*(v) = a(v)`): `a(v)` is fixed by the canonical involution `*` of `C(V)`, realized as `CliffordAlgebra.reverse`
BookProof_MajoranaClifford_a_selfAdjoint.nl:
**Self-adjointness of the field operator** (the book's `a*(v) = a(v)`):
`a(v)` is fixed by the canonical involution `*` of `C(V)`, realized as
`CliffordAlgebra.reverse`.  Physically, `a(v)` represents *a particle which is
its own antiparticle* — a Majorana fermion.

BookProof_MajoranaClifford_a_map_selfAdj.title: Symmetries act as real representations preserving self-adjointness.** For *any* real linear operator `T : V → V`, the transformed field operator `a(T v)` is again self-adjoint, so the map
BookProof_MajoranaClifford_a_map_selfAdj.nl:
**Symmetries act as real representations preserving self-adjointness.**  For
*any* real linear operator `T : V → V`, the transformed field operator `a(T v)`
is again self-adjoint, so the map `a(v) → a(T v)` preserves the
self-adjointness condition (the book's statement that the symmetry group acts by
real representations, `a(v) → a(T v)` with `T` a real operator).



**Formalization Note.** Lean 4 identifier: `BookProof.MajoranaClifford.a_map_selfAdjoint` (module `BookProof.MajoranaClifford`), line-linked source: `ChapterMajoranaClifford.lean` lines 135–141.

BookProof_MajoranaClifford_a_anticomm_sk.name: BookProof.MajoranaClifford.a_anticomm_skew
BookProof_MajoranaClifford_a_anticomm_sk.title: Creation/annihilation directions anticommute.** Given a skew-symmetric operator `J` (the book's complex structure with `⟪J v, w⟫ = -⟪v, J w⟫`; e.g
BookProof_MajoranaClifford_a_anticomm_sk.nl:
**Creation/annihilation directions anticommute.**  Given a skew-symmetric
operator `J` (the book's complex structure with `⟪J v, w⟫ = -⟪v, J w⟫`; e.g.
`J² = -1`), each vector `v` is orthogonal to `J v`, hence the corresponding field
operators anticommute: `{a(v), a(J v)} = 0`.  This is the real shadow of the
canonical anticommutation between the annihilation operator `a(v + iJv)` and the
creation operator `a(v − iJv)`.



**Formalization Note.** Lean 4 identifier: `BookProof.MajoranaClifford.a_anticomm_skew` (module `BookProof.MajoranaClifford`), line-linked source: `ChapterMajoranaClifford.lean` lines 143–155.

BookProof_ChapterMajoranaProp76_note4_co.nl:
**Conjugation preserves Note-4 unitarity.**  If `V : H → H` is a Note-4

BookProof_ChapterParityMajoranaQuant_J_u.nl:

space, a skew-symmetric `J` with `J² = -1` is orthogonal, so it preserves the metric — the
compatibility of the metric, the complex structure and the symplectic form `⟨v,Jw⟩`.

BookProof_ChapterSirkGroupTransfer_group.nl:
**Uniformity on compact time intervals.**  On `[−T, T]` the two propagators
differ by at most `T ‖a − b‖ e^{T M}`, a bound independent of `t`: generator
convergence in norm gives convergence of the flows uniformly in time on every
bounded interval.
